section_1_cloze.passage:
Pavlik, a 51-year-old part-time worker at Trader Joe's, had a passion for helping others outside of his job. He spends his free time [41] stolen bikes around Minneapolis. Known for his clever and daring [42], he has reunited countless owners with their [43] bicycles.
One day, Pavlik [44] a tip about a stolen bike being [45] on an online marketplace. Pretending to be a potential [46], he dressed himself in casual pants and a sport coat to meet the seller. At the meeting, he [47] the bike carefully, noting its make, model, and unique markings. It was definitely the one he was [48].
Pavlik asked to take it for a test ride. The seller [49] briefly before asking for some [50]. Pavlik looked at him straight in the eye and said, "Do I look like the kind of guy that steals bikes, man?" The seller, uneasy with the question, laughed [51] and hesitantly handed over the bike.
Pavlik rode off, feeling extremely [52]. An hour later, as he was handing the bike to its rightful owner, he received a [53] from the seller, "I guess you're not coming back?" Pavlik smiled and replied, "You guessed right."
"I like the ability to make others happy. And [54] bikes can be strangely fun and addictive," he said. Having every stolen bike returned was also a small [55] for the community, a symbol of progress and harmony.

questions.explanation: 上下文表明Pavlik在业余时间致力于寻找和追回被盗的自行车。track down 意为“追踪，追查到”，符合语境；pick up 意为“捡起，学会”；break down 意为“出故障，分解”；sort out 意为“整理，解决”。因此选A。
questions.supplement:
A(tracking down)：语境句：The police are tracking down the suspect. 固定搭配：track down a person, track down the source
B(picking up)：语境句：Can you pick up the kids from school? 固定搭配：pick up skills, pick up a habit
C(breaking down)：语境句：His car broke down on the way to work. 固定搭配：break down barriers, break down a problem
D(sorting out)：语境句：We need to sort out these files by date. 固定搭配：sort out a problem, sort out details

questions.explanation: Pavlik为了帮人找回自行车，会假装买家去跟卖家见面，这是一种机智大胆的“方法”或“策略”。methods 意为“方法”；contributions 意为“贡献”；efforts 意为“努力”；decisions 意为“决定”。选C最贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(contributions)：语境句：She made significant contributions to the project. 固定搭配：make a contribution, outstanding contribution
B(efforts)：语境句：Despite his best efforts, he failed the exam. 固定搭配：make an effort, spare no effort
C(methods)：语境句：We must adopt new teaching methods. 固定搭配：effective method, traditional method
D(decisions)：语境句：He makes quick decisions under pressure. 固定搭配：make a decision, final decision

questions.explanation: 文章核心事件是帮人找回“被盗的”自行车，所以这些车对原主人来说是“丢失的”。lost 意为“丢失的”，符合语境；new, broken, old 均未能体现“被盗”这一关键信息。
questions.supplement:
A(new)：语境句：She bought a brand new car yesterday. 固定搭配：new arrival, new generation
B(broken)：语境句：He fixed the broken chair with glue. 固定搭配：broken heart, broken window
C(lost)：语境句：The police helped the boy find his lost dog. 固定搭配：lost property, get lost
D(old)：语境句：This is an old tradition in our village. 固定搭配：old age, old friend

questions.explanation: 句意为Pavlik“收到”了一条关于被盗自行车的线索。receive a tip 意为“收到线索/情报”，符合语境；selected（选择），shared（分享），rejected（拒绝）均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(selected)：语境句：He was selected as the team captain. 固定搭配：carefully selected, randomly selected
B(shared)：语境句：They shared their experiences with the group. 固定搭配：share with someone, share an opinion
C(rejected)：语境句：His proposal was rejected by the board. 固定搭配：firmly reject, reject an offer
D(received)：语境句：She received a letter from her pen pal. 固定搭配：receive a tip, receive an award

questions.explanation: 被盗的自行车正在网络市场上“被出售”。being sold 意为“正在被卖”，非常符合二手交易平台的语境；posted 也有“发布”之意，但在表达“商品在售”时 sold 更为直接且常见。
questions.supplement:
A(posted)：语境句：Important notices will be posted on the bulletin board. 固定搭配：post a notice, keep someone posted
B(sold)：语境句：The house was sold at a high price. 固定搭配：be sold out, best-sold
C(discussed)：语境句：The issue was discussed at the meeting. 固定搭配：discuss with someone, widely discussed
D(shown)：语境句：The data shown in the graph is accurate. 固定搭配：show off, show up

questions.explanation: 他要跟卖家（seller）见面，自然是假装成潜在的“买家”（buyer）。前后词语形成逻辑上的对应。
questions.supplement:
A(buyer)：语境句：The company is looking for a potential buyer. 固定搭配：potential buyer, impulsive buyer
B(seller)：语境句：The seller agreed to reduce the price. 固定搭配：best seller, street seller
C(worker)：语境句：He is a hard-working office worker. 固定搭配：social worker, migrant worker
D(officer)：语境句：The police officer asked for my identification. 固定搭配：police officer, commanding officer

questions.explanation: 在见面时，他仔细“检查”了这辆自行车，记下了它的品牌、型号和独特标记。examine 意为“仔细检查”，符合语境；fix（修理），balance（平衡），adjust（调整）均不符。
questions.supplement:
A(fixed)：语境句：My dad fixed the leaky pipe in the bathroom. 固定搭配：fix a date, fix a problem
B(balanced)：语境句：We need a balanced diet to stay healthy. 固定搭配：balanced diet, keep balanced
C(adjusted)：语境句：She adjusted her glasses and continued reading. 固定搭配：adjust to, make an adjustment
D(examined)：语境句：The doctor examined the patient thoroughly. 固定搭配：examine carefully, cross-examine

questions.explanation: 经过检查确认，这绝对就是他一直在“寻找（猎寻）”的那辆车。hunt for / hunt 意为“搜寻，寻找”，与第一段他致力于找回被盗车辆的背景呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(admiring)：语境句：We stood there admiring the beautiful sunset. 固定搭配：admire someone for, secret admirer
B(hunting)：语境句：Lions spend much of their time hunting for food. 固定搭配：hunt for, job hunting
C(evaluating)：语境句：The teacher is evaluating the students' performance. 固定搭配：evaluate a situation, properly evaluate
D(picturing)：语境句：She was picturing herself winning the race. 固定搭配：picture in one's mind, picture someone doing

questions.explanation: Pavlik提出要试骑，作为卖家对于陌生人的这种要求自然会“犹豫”（hesitate），这与后文他要求给点担保以及“hesitantly handed over”相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(laughed)：语境句：Everyone laughed at his funny joke. 固定搭配：laugh at, burst into laughter
B(interrupted)：语境句：Please don't interrupt me while I'm speaking. 固定搭配：interrupt a conversation, be interrupted by
C(approved)：语境句：The committee approved the new budget plan. 固定搭配：approve of, fully approve
D(hesitated)：语境句：He hesitated for a moment before answering. 固定搭配：hesitate to do, without hesitation

questions.explanation: 卖家在同意让陌生人试骑前，要求对方提供一些“担保”（guarantee），如押金或身份证等。explanation（解释），consideration（考虑），evidence（证据）均不符合交易试用的常理。
questions.supplement:
A(explanation)：语境句：He owes me an explanation for his absence. 固定搭配：give an explanation, logical explanation
B(consideration)：语境句：Safety is our primary consideration. 固定搭配：take into consideration, under consideration
C(guarantee)：语境句：This product comes with a one-year guarantee. 固定搭配：provide a guarantee, under guarantee
D(evidence)：语境句：There is no clear evidence to prove his guilt. 固定搭配：solid evidence, provide evidence

questions.explanation: Pavlik反问卖家“我看起来像偷车贼吗？”，卖家对此感到不安（uneasy），因此笑得应该很“尴尬”（awkwardly）。loudly（大声地），heartily（尽情地），unexpectedly（出乎意料地）均不符合这种略显心虚、紧张的氛围。
questions.supplement:
A(loudly)：语境句：He spoke loudly so everyone could hear him. 固定搭配：laugh loudly, speak loudly
B(awkwardly)：语境句：She smiled awkwardly when asked about her age. 固定搭配：smile awkwardly, stand awkwardly
C(heartily)：语境句：They laughed heartily at the hilarious comedy. 固定搭配：laugh heartily, welcome heartily
D(unexpectedly)：语境句：The weather changed unexpectedly in the afternoon. 固定搭配：arrive unexpectedly, happen unexpectedly

questions.explanation: Pavlik骑车离开，成功把被盗的自行车拿了回来，此时他的心情应该是极度“兴奋的”（excited）。confident（自信的），anxious（焦虑的），guilty（内疚的）都不足以表达这种行侠仗义成功后的激动情绪。
questions.supplement:
A(confident)：语境句：She is confident about her chances of winning. 固定搭配：be confident of, highly confident
B(anxious)：语境句：He felt anxious before the job interview. 固定搭配：be anxious about, be anxious to do
C(excited)：语境句：The kids were excited about going to the zoo. 固定搭配：be excited about, extremely excited
D(guilty)：语境句：He felt guilty for lying to his best friend. 固定搭配：feel guilty, be found guilty

questions.explanation: 一小时后，卖家发现他没回去，于是发来消息问“我猜你不打算回来了？”这是一种通过手机发送的信息，text（短信）最符合现代生活情境；letter（信件）太慢且不合理。
questions.supplement:
A(text)：语境句：I sent him a text message yesterday. 固定搭配：send a text, text message
B(letter)：语境句：She wrote a letter of apology to the manager. 固定搭配：write a letter, formal letter
C(complaint)：语境句：The store received a complaint from a customer. 固定搭配：make a complaint, letter of complaint
D(warning)：语境句：The sign gave a warning of danger ahead. 固定搭配：issue a warning, without warning

questions.explanation: Pavlik表示，帮别人找回被盗的自行车会让人上瘾。recover 此处意为“寻回，找回（失物）”，高度概括了他在全文中从事的行为。
questions.supplement:
A(reserving)：语境句：I am reserving a table for two at the restaurant. 固定搭配：reserve a seat, reserve the right
B(exploring)：语境句：They are exploring new ways to save energy. 固定搭配：explore space, explore possibilities
C(recovering)：语境句：She is recovering from a severe cold. 固定搭配：recover from, recover stolen property
D(collecting)：语境句：He has been collecting stamps since childhood. 固定搭配：collect data, collect information

questions.explanation: 找回每一辆自行车对于社区来说都是一次小小的“胜利”（victory），它是进步与和谐的象征。kindness（善良），shock（震惊），adventure（冒险）均无法与“a symbol of progress and harmony”形成足够力度的并列升华。
questions.supplement:
A(kindness)：语境句：Thank you for your kindness and support. 固定搭配：show kindness, an act of kindness
B(victory)：语境句：The team celebrated their victory in the final match. 固定搭配：achieve a victory, celebrate a victory
C(shock)：语境句：The sudden news came as a great shock to us. 固定搭配：in shock, electric shock
D(adventure)：语境句：He loves reading stories about space adventure. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure, go on an adventure

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who works fewer hours than a full-time employee
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作同位语，说明主语 Pavlik 的身份；常以连字符连接 part 和 time 构成复合形容词修饰 worker。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students find jobs as part-time workers in supermarkets.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生在超市找到兼职工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a 51-year-old part-time worker at Trader Joe's

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a strong enthusiasm or interest in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 have 为过去式 had，表示过去持续的状态；后接名词短语 helping others 作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has a passion for classical music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对古典音乐有强烈的热情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had a passion for helping others

vocab_pack.definition_en: to find someone or something after a search
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 tracking down 为动名词短语，作 spend 的宾语（常见结构 spend time (in) doing sth）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The police managed to track down the stolen car.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警方设法追踪到了被盗的汽车。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tracking down stolen bikes

vocab_pack.definition_en: famous or recognized because of a particular quality or action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 Known for 为过去分词短语作状语，表示被动含义（他被人们知道因……）；首字母大写因句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: This city is known for its historical landmarks.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城以其历史地标而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Known for his clever and daring methods

vocab_pack.definition_en: willing to take risks; bold
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作形容词修饰名词 methods，与 clever 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The explorer made a daring journey into the jungle.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 探险家进行了一次大胆的丛林之旅。
vocab_pack.from_passage: clever and daring methods

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring people or things together again after being separated
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 has reunited 为现在完成时，第三人称单数形式；常与 with 连用（reunite sb with sth）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lost child was reunited with his parents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 走失的孩子与父母重聚了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he has reunited countless owners with their lost bicycles

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get a piece of information or advice about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 received 为过去式，动词谓语；a tip 为可数名词；about 后接名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The detective received a tip about the robbery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 侦探收到了关于这起抢劫案的线索。
vocab_pack.from_passage: received a tip about a stolen bike

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be offered for sale; to be in the process of being purchased
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 being sold 为现在分词被动形式（being + 过去分词），作后置定语修饰 a stolen bike，表示“正在被出售的”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The items being sold at the market are quite cheap.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 市场上正在出售的物品相当便宜。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a stolen bike being sold on an online marketplace

vocab_pack.definition_en: to act as if you are someone or something that you are not
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 Pretending to be 为现在分词短语作状语，表示主动的伴随动作；pretend 后接不定式。
vocab_pack.example_en: He pretended to be asleep when his mother came in.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 妈妈进来时他假装睡着了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Pretending to be a potential buyer

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put clothes on oneself
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 dressed 为过去式谓语；himself 为反身代词，强调主语自己；in 后接服装名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She dressed herself in a red dress for the party.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她穿了一件红裙去参加派对。
vocab_pack.from_passage: dressed himself in casual pants and a sport coat

vocab_pack.definition_en: informal; suitable for ordinary use
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作形容词修饰名词 pants，表示服装风格。
vocab_pack.example_en: He wore casual shoes to the office.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他穿着休闲鞋去办公室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: casual pants and a sport coat

vocab_pack.definition_en: to inspect or look at something closely
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 examined 为过去式谓语，后接宾语 the bike 和副词 carefully。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor examined the patient thoroughly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生仔细检查了病人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he examined the bike carefully

vocab_pack.definition_en: the brand or manufacturer of a product
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 品牌；型号（尤指制造厂商）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 make 为名词，与 model 并列，表示自行车的品牌和型号。
vocab_pack.example_en: What make is your computer?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你的电脑是什么牌子？
vocab_pack.from_passage: noting its make, model, and unique markings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to search for something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 was hunting 为过去进行时，表示当时正在寻找（那辆车）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The police are hunting for the escaped prisoner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警方正在搜寻越狱的囚犯。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the one he was hunting

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: take it for a test ride
vocab_pack.definition_en: to try using a vehicle or bicycle to see if it works properly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 take 为不定式（to take），作 asked 的宾语；it 指代自行车；for a test ride 为介词短语表目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: I would like to take this car for a test ride before buying it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我想先试驾一下这辆车再买。
vocab_pack.from_passage: asked to take it for a test ride

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pause before doing something because you are unsure or nervous
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 hesitated 为过去式谓语，后接副词 briefly 和 before 引导的介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She hesitated before answering the question.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她回答前犹豫了一下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The seller hesitated briefly

vocab_pack.term: look someone straight in the eye
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: looked at him straight in the eye
vocab_pack.definition_en: to look directly at someone to show honesty, confidence, or challenge
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 直视某人的眼睛（表示坦诚、自信或挑战）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 looked 为过去式谓语；straight in the eye 为固定短语，表示直视。
vocab_pack.example_en: He looked his father straight in the eye and told the truth.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他直视父亲的眼睛，说出了真相。
vocab_pack.from_passage: looked at him straight in the eye

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a similar appearance to; to seem to be
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 look like 为一般现在时谓语，主语为 I；后接宾语 the kind of guy。
vocab_pack.example_en: That cloud looks like a rabbit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那朵云看起来像一只兔子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Do I look like the kind of guy that steals bikes?

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling anxious, worried, or uncomfortable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作形容词作系动词 felt? 实际上是“The seller, uneasy with the question”中 uneasy 为形容词作状语/独立主格？原文结构：The seller, uneasy with the question, laughed... 这里 uneasy 为形容词短语补充说明主语状态（伴随状语）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He felt uneasy about the upcoming exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对即将到来的考试感到不安。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The seller, uneasy with the question

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that is uncomfortable, embarrassing, or clumsy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作副词修饰谓语动词 laughed，表示笑的方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: He smiled awkwardly after dropping his plate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他打翻盘子后尴尬地笑了笑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: laughed awkwardly and hesitantly

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something to someone, especially after being asked or forced to do so
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 handed over 为过去式谓语，后接宾语 the bike。
vocab_pack.example_en: The thief was forced to hand over the stolen goods.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 小偷被迫交出赃物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: hesitantly handed over the bike

vocab_pack.definition_en: to leave on a bicycle, horse, or vehicle
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 rode off 为过去式谓语，表示他骑车离开。
vocab_pack.example_en: She rode off on her bike without saying goodbye.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她没道别就骑自行车走了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Pavlik rode off

vocab_pack.definition_en: to a very great degree; very
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作副词修饰形容词 excited，表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is extremely important to follow the rules.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 遵守规则极其重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: feeling extremely excited

vocab_pack.definition_en: the person who legally or morally owns something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 合法所有者；真正的主人
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为名词短语作介词 to 的宾语；rightful 为形容词修饰 owner。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lost wallet was returned to its rightful owner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 丢失的钱包被归还给了它的合法主人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its rightful owner

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get a text message sent by someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 received 为过去式谓语；a text 为可数名词；from 后接名词短语 the seller。
vocab_pack.example_en: I received a text from my brother this morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我今天早上收到了弟弟的短信。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he received a text from the seller

vocab_pack.definition_en: to return to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 are coming back 为现在进行时，表示按计划或即将发生的动作（在间接引语中）。
vocab_pack.example_en: When are you coming back from your trip?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你什么时候旅行回来？
vocab_pack.from_passage: I guess you're not coming back?

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a correct guess
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 guessed 为过去式谓语；right 为副词修饰 guessed。
vocab_pack.example_en: She guessed the answer right on the first try.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她第一次就猜对了答案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You guessed right.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to feel happy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 make 为不定式（ability to make），others 为宾语，happy 为形容词作宾补（make + 宾语 + 形容词）。
vocab_pack.example_en: A kind word can make someone happy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一句善意的话可以让人开心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I like the ability to make others happy.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get back something that was lost or stolen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 recovering 为动名词作主语，与后面的 bikes 构成动名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The police recovered the stolen jewelry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警方追回了被盗的珠宝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: recovering bikes

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing someone to want to do something repeatedly (like an addiction)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作形容词，与 fun 并列，作表语；描述 recovering bikes 的特点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The game is so addictive that players spend hours on it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个游戏太让人上瘾了，玩家会花好几个小时在上面。
vocab_pack.from_passage: strangely fun and addictive

vocab_pack.definition_en: a success achieved in a competition, fight, or effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作可数名词，前有 a small 修饰，后为 for the community。
vocab_pack.example_en: Winning the match was a great victory for the team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 赢得比赛对队伍来说是一场巨大的胜利。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a small victory for the community

vocab_pack.definition_en: forward or onward movement toward a goal; development
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为不可数名词，与 harmony 并列作介词 of 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The student has made great progress in English.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个学生在英语上取得了很大进步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a symbol of progress and harmony

vocab_pack.definition_en: a state of peaceful agreement and cooperation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为不可数名词，与 progress 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The family lived in harmony for many years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个家庭多年来和睦相处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a symbol of progress and harmony

section_2_word_form.passage:
Since decades ago, technology [56] an essential part of education. More and more schools are using digital tools to enhance learning experiences. For example, many classrooms now have interactive whiteboards that allow teachers to present lessons [57] a more engaging way. These tools not only make learning more interesting but also help students to understand complex concepts more easily. [58] to this, online resources provide students with [59] wealth of information that they can access anytime and anywhere.
However, the use of technology in education also brings some challenges. One of the biggest problems is that students can become too [60] on digital devices. Spending too much time on screens may lead to a lack of focus and even health issues. Moreover, not all students have equal access to technology, [61] a digital divide and affecting their various learning [62].
Despite these challenges, the benefits of technology in education can not be ignored. When used [63], technology can be a powerful tool to support teaching and learning. It can provide personalized [64] learning experiences and help students develop important skills for the future. As we move forward, it is important to find a balance between traditional teaching methods [65] the use of technology to create the best possible learning environment for all students.

questions.explanation: 句首有时间状语 'Since decades ago'（自几十年前以来），表明动作从过去一直持续到现在，需要使用现在完成时。主语 technology 为不可数名词，谓语动词用单数，故填 has become。
questions.supplement: 正确形(has become)：语境句：Smartphones have become a necessity in modern life. 固定搭配：become popular, become accustomed to。原词become其它变形：became(过去式), becoming(adj.合适的)

questions.explanation: 考查介词固定搭配。'in a ... way' 表示“以……的方式”。此处意为“以一种更吸引人的方式呈现课程”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(in)：语境句：He explained the rules in a clear way. 固定搭配：in a way, in this way, in no way

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换与固定短语。此处需要一个表达“除此之外”的连接词组。所给词为 add，常考固定搭配 'In addition to this' 意为“除此之外”。（注：也可填 Added 作为过去分词短语，'Added to this' 同样意为“除此之外”，但高中常考的变形首选 In addition）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(In addition)：语境句：In addition to his salary, he earns a lot from investments. 固定搭配：in addition, in addition to。原词add其它变形：added(adj./v-ed), additional(adj.), additionally(adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词固定搭配。'a wealth of' 是固定短语，意为“大量的，丰富的”，此处指在线资源为学生提供了丰富的信息。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：The library has a wealth of books on history. 固定搭配：a wealth of, a variety of, a lot of

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。become 是系动词，后需接形容词作表语。'become dependent on' 意为“对……产生依赖”，故将动词 depend 变为形容词 dependent。
questions.supplement: 正确形(dependent)：语境句：Children are dependent on their parents for food. 固定搭配：be dependent on, strictly dependent。原词depend其它变形：dependence(n.), independent(adj.), independence(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。逗号前为完整的句子，此处表示前面整个事件导致自然而然的结果，需用现在分词作结果状语；同时与后面的 'affecting' 形成并列结构，故填 creating。
questions.supplement: 正确形(creating)：语境句：The storm caused heavy damage, creating massive traffic jams. 固定搭配：create opportunities, create an environment。原词create其它变形：creation(n.), creative(adj.), creativity(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。opportunity 在此处作可数名词，意为“机会”。前面有 'various'（各种各样的）修饰，说明存在多种学习机会，因此需用复数形式 opportunities。
questions.supplement: 正确形(opportunities)：语境句：Studying abroad provides many opportunities for personal growth. 固定搭配：seize the opportunity, job opportunities。原词opportunity其它变形：opportune(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处修饰动词过去分词 used，需要使用副词。将形容词 proper 变为 properly，意为“当被恰当使用时”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(properly)：语境句：Make sure the equipment is functioning properly. 固定搭配：behave properly, function properly。原词proper其它变形：improper(adj.), propriety(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处需用形容词修饰名词词组 'learning experiences'。将动词 suit 变为形容词 suitable，意为“合适的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(suitable)：语境句：We need to find a suitable location for the picnic. 固定搭配：be suitable for, suitable candidates。原词suit其它变形：unsuitable(adj.), suitably(adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查连词固定搭配。前文有 'between'，与之固定搭配的连词是 'and'，构成 'between A and B' 结构，意为“在传统教学方法和技术使用之间找到平衡”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The relationship between teachers and students is important. 固定搭配：between... and..., both... and...

vocab_pack.definition_en: a necessary component
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作become的表语，与an搭配，表示‘成为必要部分’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise is an essential part of a healthy lifestyle.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 定期锻炼是健康生活方式的重要组成部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: technology has become an essential part of education

vocab_pack.definition_en: electronic device or software used for a specific purpose
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 数字工具（电子设备或软件）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中复数形式作宾语，与are using搭配，表示‘使用数字工具’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many digital tools can help students organize their notes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多数字工具可以帮助学生整理笔记。
vocab_pack.from_passage: schools are using digital tools to enhance learning experiences

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large touchscreen display used in classrooms for teaching
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中复数形式作have的宾语，表示拥有此类设备。
vocab_pack.example_en: The interactive whiteboard allows teachers to illustrate concepts visually.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 互动白板让老师能够直观地展示概念。
vocab_pack.from_passage: many classrooms now have interactive whiteboards

vocab_pack.definition_en: materials available on the internet
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中复数形式作主语，谓语provide与主语一致，表示‘提供在线资源’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Online resources make it easy to find information.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在线资源使查找信息变得容易。
vocab_pack.from_passage: online resources provide students with a wealth of information

vocab_pack.definition_en: the gap between those who have access to digital technology and those who do not
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作creating的宾语，现在分词短语作结果状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Efforts are needed to bridge the digital divide in rural areas.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 需要努力缩小农村地区的数字鸿沟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: creating a digital divide and affecting their various learning opportunities

vocab_pack.definition_en: improve the process of gaining knowledge
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式to enhance作目的状语，enhance为原形，learning experiences为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Virtual reality can enhance learning experiences in science classes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 虚拟现实可以提升科学课的学习体验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to enhance learning experiences

vocab_pack.definition_en: cause learning to be interesting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中make + 宾语learning + 形容词补足语interesting，more是比较级，强调程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hands-on activities make learning interesting for young children.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 动手活动让幼儿学习变得有趣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: make learning more interesting

vocab_pack.definition_en: assist someone in comprehending something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中help后接宾语students+带to的不定式to understand，表示‘帮助学生理解’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teachers often use examples to help students to understand abstract concepts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师常使用例子帮助学生理解抽象概念。
vocab_pack.from_passage: help students to understand complex concepts

vocab_pack.definition_en: deliver lessons to students
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式to present lessons作宾语补足语，lessons为复数泛指。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teachers use various methods to present lessons effectively.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师用各种方法有效授课。
vocab_pack.from_passage: allow teachers to present lessons in a more engaging way

vocab_pack.definition_en: be able to use at any time and any place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中情态动词can后接原形access，anytime and anywhere为并列副词短语修饰access。
vocab_pack.example_en: With cloud storage, you can access your files anytime and anywhere.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有了云存储，你可以随时随地访问文件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that they can access anytime and anywhere

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: Spending too much time on screens
vocab_pack.definition_en: use screens (phone, computer, TV) for a period
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中动名词短语Spending...作主语，too much修饰time，on screens表示在屏幕上。
vocab_pack.example_en: Spending too much time on screens can lead to eye strain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花太多时间在屏幕上会导致眼睛疲劳。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Spending too much time on screens may lead to a lack of focus

vocab_pack.definition_en: influence chances to learn
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中现在分词affecting作结果状语，their various修饰learning opportunities。
vocab_pack.example_en: Lack of funding can affect learning opportunities for underprivileged students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 资金短缺会影响贫困学生的学习机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: affecting their various learning opportunities

vocab_pack.definition_en: acquire abilities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中help后接省略to的不定式develop，important修饰skills。
vocab_pack.example_en: Internships help students develop professional skills.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 实习帮助学生培养职业技能。
vocab_pack.from_passage: help students develop important skills for the future

vocab_pack.definition_en: a method that captures attention
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中in a more engaging way为介词短语作状语，more为比较级修饰engaging。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher presented the topic in an engaging way.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师用吸引人的方式介绍了主题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in a more engaging way

vocab_pack.definition_en: difficult idea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中复数形式作understand的宾语，more easily修饰understand。
vocab_pack.example_en: Visual aids help students grasp complex concepts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 视觉辅助工具帮助学生掌握复杂概念。
vocab_pack.from_passage: understand complex concepts more easily

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large amount of (usually positive)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中修饰不可数名词information，表示提供大量信息。
vocab_pack.example_en: The internet offers a wealth of knowledge.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 互联网提供大量的知识。
vocab_pack.from_passage: provide students with a wealth of information

vocab_pack.definition_en: inability to concentrate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中a lack of为固定搭配，lack为名词，作lead to的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Lack of focus often results in poor performance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 注意力不集中常导致表现不佳。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lead to a lack of focus

vocab_pack.definition_en: medical problem
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中复数形式作lead to的宾语，even表递进。
vocab_pack.example_en: Prolonged sitting can cause health issues such as back pain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 久坐会导致背痛等健康问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: health issues

vocab_pack.definition_en: the same opportunity to use something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中have equal access to为动宾结构，access为名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government ensures all citizens have equal access to healthcare.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府确保所有公民平等享有医疗保健。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have equal access to technology

vocab_pack.definition_en: very effective instrument
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语，a powerful tool，与can be连用。
vocab_pack.example_en: A positive attitude is a powerful tool for success.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 积极的态度是成功的强大工具。
vocab_pack.from_passage: technology can be a powerful tool

vocab_pack.definition_en: besides, as well as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中介词短语作状语，后接代词this指代上文内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: In addition to reading, she enjoys writing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 除了阅读，她还喜欢写作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In addition to this

vocab_pack.definition_en: one of the most significant issues
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作主语，系动词is；结构one of + 最高级 + 复数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: One of the biggest problems facing society is climate change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 社会面临的最大问题之一是气候变化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One of the biggest problems is that

vocab_pack.definition_en: start relying on (excessively)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中become为系动词，后接形容词dependent+介词on；too修饰程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students can become dependent on calculators for basic math.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生做基础数学时会变得依赖计算器。
vocab_pack.from_passage: students can become too dependent on digital devices

vocab_pack.definition_en: result in an insufficient amount of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中may lead to为谓语，to为介词，后接名词短语a lack of。
vocab_pack.example_en: Excessive screen time can lead to a lack of physical activity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 过多的屏幕时间会导致缺乏身体活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: may lead to a lack of focus

vocab_pack.definition_en: in spite of these difficulties
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中Despite为介词，引导让步状语；these修饰challenges。
vocab_pack.example_en: Despite challenges, the team achieved its goal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管有挑战，团队实现了目标。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Despite these challenges

vocab_pack.definition_en: must be paid attention to; cannot be disregarded
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中情态动词can的否定式+被动语态be ignored；原文写作can not分开，标准为cannot。
vocab_pack.example_en: The impact of social media on teenagers cannot be ignored.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 社交媒体对青少年的影响不能忽视。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the benefits of technology in education can not be ignored

vocab_pack.definition_en: if used correctly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为时间状语从句的省略形式，完整为when it is used properly；used为过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: When used properly, this medicine has few side effects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 正确使用时，这种药物副作用很小。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When used properly, technology can be a powerful tool

vocab_pack.definition_en: achieve equilibrium between two things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式to find a balance between...and...作真正主语；it is important to find。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to find a balance between study and leisure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在学习和休闲之间找到平衡很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: find a balance between traditional teaching methods and the use of technology

vocab_pack.definition_en: conventional way of teaching
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中复数形式作between的宾语之一，traditional修饰methods。
vocab_pack.example_en: Some educators still prefer traditional teaching methods like lectures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一些教育者仍偏爱讲座等传统教学方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: between traditional teaching methods and the use of technology

vocab_pack.definition_en: employing technology
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作主语，定冠词the特指‘在教学中技术的使用’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The use of technology in the workplace has increased efficiency.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工作场所使用技术提高了效率。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the use of technology in education

vocab_pack.definition_en: many years in the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中与Since连用作时间状语，decades为复数泛指，ago表示‘之前’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Decades ago, computers were not common in schools.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 几十年前，电脑在学校并不常见。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Since decades ago

vocab_pack.definition_en: advantages that technology brings
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作主语，复数，谓语为can not be ignored。
vocab_pack.example_en: The benefits of technology in medicine are enormous.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 技术在医学领域的益处是巨大的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the benefits of technology in education

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: create the best possible learning environment
vocab_pack.definition_en: establish a setting for learning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式to create表示目的，the best possible修饰learning environment。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teachers should create a learning environment that encourages questions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师应创造鼓励提问的学习环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to create the best possible learning environment for all students

vocab_pack.definition_en: assist instruction and study
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式to support...作定语修饰tool；teaching and learning为动名词作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This new platform supports teaching and learning through interactive content.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个新平台通过互动内容支持教学。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a powerful tool to support teaching and learning

vocab_pack.definition_en: customized educational activity tailored to individual needs
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为provide的宾语，personalized和suitable均为形容词修饰experiences。
vocab_pack.example_en: Adaptive software provides a personalized learning experience for each student.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自适应软件为每个学生提供个性化的学习体验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: provide personalized suitable learning experiences

vocab_pack.definition_en: progress, advance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中as we move forward为时间状语从句，一般现在时，we为第一人称复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: As we move forward, we must embrace change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着我们向前发展，必须拥抱变化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As we move forward
